From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BluePeak: proof window, acceptance checklist & demo runway

Hey Evan + Priya — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can lock the kickoff and make the POC timeboxed and measurable. TL;DR: kickoff week of Sept 13, 4-week proof window, weekly checkpoints, final readout with demo & acceptance sign-off.

Scope and success hypothesis
- Redwood runs inference for up to 50k monthly requests across two core flows (customer support summarization and search reranking).
- Success = 95th perc latency < 450ms for 512-token prompts AND match/beat baseline reranking quality on your internal dev set (we'll define metric below).

Acceptance checklist (attached as matrix)
- Performance baseline + runbook
- Eval set + scoring rubric (bluepeak to provide)
- Security & data handling checklist (we flagged items during call)
- Stakeholder owners for infra, data, and product

Proposed timeline (high level)
- Sept 13: Kickoff (30–45m) — align owners, share eval dataset, confirm SLOs
- Week 1: Sandbox runs, integration smoke tests
- Weeks 2–3: Controlled live traffic ramp and monitoring
- Week 4: Final readout + demo, sign-off or list of follow-ups

Owners (initial)
- Redwood: Aditya (AM lead), Camila (solutions engineer), Jonas (SRE contact)
- BluePeak: Evan (engineering lead), Priya (product/POC sponsor)

Next steps (can we do these by end of week?):
1) BluePeak to share eval set (sample of 200 queries + expected labels) and security point-of-contact.
2) Redwood to send kickoff invite for Sept 13 (propose 10am PT / 1pm ET).
3) Exchange access details for staging environment + IP allowlist.

Attachments: BluePeak_POC_acceptance_matrix.xlsx (xlsx) — includes metric targets and owner column; BluePeak_security_snippet.pdf (pdf) — snippets from our SOC2 controls relevant to data residency.

If this looks correct, Evan/Priya can reply with any changes and we’ll lock the kickoff.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

Thanks Aditya — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Evaluation dataset: we can share 300 labeled queries (will remove PII). ETA for dataset: Thurs Sept 2.
2) Latency target: we want to aim for 400ms at p95 for the reranking flow (we can be flexible on summarization).
3) Security: our infra team will need the list of IPs and the HSM/KMS model for key rotation (send via secure channel).

Kickoff: Sept 13 at 10am PT works for us. Please send calendar invite.

One ask — can Redwood include a brief paragraph in the kickoff deck that outlines fallback behavior (what happens if latency exceeds SLO during ramp)? Our ops team wants the rollback/fallback steps documented.

Evan

Hi Evan / Priya — looping in a bit more detail on cadence and operational ownership so we’re aligned heading into kickoff.

Suggested cadence and meeting agenda (weekly, 30 minutes)- Week 0 (Kickoff): objectives, owners, data handoff, security alignment (30–45m)- Weekly standups (Tue 30m): status, blockers, metrics (p95 latency, error rate, correctness on sample)- Midpoint review (end of week 2, 60m): deep-dive on metrics, tuning plan- Final readout (end of week 4, 60m): live demo, pass/fail checklist, next steps

Operational owners and quick contacts- Integration & infra: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com) — handles staging, allowlist, and runtime tuning- Eval & quality: Camila Reyes (camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com) — coordinates eval runs and scoring rubric- Commercial & escalation: Aditya Rao — AM and sponsor for scheduling/contract items

Fallback and rollback (summary)
- Toggle to lower-capacity model variant (automated fallback)
- Reduce concurrency and enable prefix-caching for critical flows
- If SLOs not achievable within 48 hours of mitigations, pause live traffic and schedule immediate post-mortem with both teams

Deliverables before kickoff
- BluePeak: sanitized eval set (due Sept 2) and security POC contact
- Redwood: kickoff deck + short fallback appendix + IP list and staging hostnames (will share via secure doc)

I attached a draft meeting agenda and a pared-down acceptance matrix (see BluePeak_POC_acceptance_matrix.xlsx). I’ll update the file after any changes from you.
